data.name: Ohelah
data.gender_notes: Ohelah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ohel', meaning 'tent', this name is believed to symbolize God's protection and shelter. In Islamic tradition, it is a reminder of the tent of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions during their journey from Mecca to Medina. The name Ohelah carries the meaning “Tent of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ohelah usually hope their child will grow to embody tent of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ohelah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

During this Journey, they were molded into a community, and the name Ohelah serves as a reminder of this significant period in Islamic history.

It serves as a reminder that, like how a tent provides shelter from the elements, God is always present and willing to protect His believers from the trials and tribulations of life. Moreover, it is a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) deep spiritual connection to God, as he sought His guidance and protection throughout his life. Overall, Ohelah is a name that instills a sense of security and faith, inspiring believers to turn to God in times of need.
